body.name: Projected deterministic-prefix arm variance
body.construction: For \(0\le c\le B\), \(h=((z_i,y_i))_{i=1}^{T_c}\in\mathsf H_c\), \(a\in\mathcal A\), and an integer \(k\ge0\), put \(j=\min\{k,\sum_{i=1}^{T_c}\mathbf 1\{z_i=a\}\}\). Let \(\widehat v_a(k;h)\) equal the unbiased sample variance of the first \(j\) coordinates \(y_i\) with \(z_i=a\), projected onto \([\ell^2,u^2]\), when \(j\ge2\); set \(\widehat v_a(k;h)=\ell^2\) when \(j<2\). This defines a Borel function on every canonical history, and on feasible histories it uses the requested \(k\) arm observations whenever they exist.
